steps.say: A naming word names a person, animal, place or thing. We call it a noun.
A doing word is an action. We call it a verb.
A describing word tells us more about a noun. We call it an adjective.
Look at this sentence: The big dog runs.
Dog is the naming word and runs is the doing word. Big is the describing word.
steps.show: dog: noun, runs: verb, big: adjective

check.prompt: Find the doing word. 'The fish swims fast.'
check.explanation: Swims is the doing word. It is what the fish does.

options.why: Fast tells us how it swims.
